chile-carretera-austral-northern-stage.title: Chile · Carretera Austral Northern Stage
chile-carretera-austral-northern-stage.slogan: A 529 km loop out of Hornopirén ferry

sections.advice: This Pumalín forest → Chaitén overnight stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Use Chaitén overnight → Futaleufú river roads as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

pamir-highway-murghab-karakul.slogan: Murghab to Karakul, over 4655 m · one way, about 266 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Murghab

waypoints.name: Ak Baital Pass
waypoints.advice: Ak Baital Pass comes up 133 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Karakul, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Karakul
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 266 km.

sections.advice: Murghab → Ak Baital Pass climbs about 4655 m in 70 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ak Baital Pass → Karakul drops about 4655 m over 63 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

pamir-highway-murghab-karakul.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Pamir Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Murghab → Ak Baital Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.7%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Ak Baital Pass → Karakul
scenicChapters.narrative: 4655 m come off over 126 km at around 7.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

pamir-highway-murghab-karakul.story: A one-way ride of 266 km, Murghob to the finish - roughly 3 h 40 in the saddle. The highest point is about 4,650 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Rhine Romantic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-watchtower-wp-3-4-limessection-be.story: From Bad Schwalbach it runs 68 km to Bad Schwalbach; allow about 1 h 10 of riding. The stops in between: Watchtowers WP 2/35 to 2/48 including the, Limessection between watchtowers WP 2/13 a and back through Watchtowers WP 2/35 to 2/48 including the. The line favours views over speed.
